answer.evidence: The image is a full 96x96 tile with a constant silhouette width of 96 on every row. It is a seamless dark purple ground texture with scattered lighter pixels and thin crack lines. There is no front-edge line, no eave shadow, no ellipse and no roof plane. No front face is drawn, and the column scans show only random speckle. It is a flat terrain fill, which fits the terrain kind, so it reads as a flat top-down surface.
